parties: HMA Agro Industries Limited (Target Company); Inter-se transfer amongst promoters
headline: HMA Agro Industries Limited: Promoter inter-se transfer by gift reported under Takeover Regulations
sum: HMA Agro Industries Limited has filed a report with NSE under Regulation 10(7) of the Takeover Regulations 2011 disclosing an inter-se transfer of shares amongst promoters effected by way of gift. The filing confirms compliance with Regulation 10(1)(a)(i) for substantial acquisition mechanics.
implication: Inter-se promoter transfers by gift are exempt from the general substantial acquisition threshold but still trigger mandatory Regulation 10(7) disclosure and reporting; this filing demonstrates the regulatory boundary between family restructuring and arm's-length acquisition triggers.
detail: HMA Agro Industries Limited notified the NSE of a share transfer between promoters executed as a gift, which falls under the exemption in Regulation 10(1)(a)(i) of the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011. The company has submitted the required report under Regulation 10(7) in accordance with takeover disclosure norms. The transfer appears to be an internal promoter restructuring and does not involve a change of control or material dilution to external shareholders.
